title: Parallel Sum (jthread & atomic)

links.title: C++ Core Guidelines CP.2: avoid data races

hints: SafeCounter: make the member a std::atomic<long long>; ++ on it (or fetch_add(1)) is then one indivisible step. A plain long long loses increments when two threads collide.
parallel_sum: split the vector into `threads` chunks. Give each thread its OWN slot in a std::vector<long long> partial(threads) - no sharing, no lock needed.
Create the std::jthread objects inside a block { ... }: their destructors join at the closing brace, so all partial sums are ready after it.
Chunk bounds: chunk = (n + threads - 1) / threads; begin = min(n, t * chunk); end = min(n, begin + chunk). Capture begin/end/t by value in the lambda, the vectors by reference.
